# Speak in Progress

> A specialized YouTube production suite and deliberate spoken English practice framework built by Md. Selim for PC screen recording, calibrated teleprompter pacing, unscripted 90-second memory retellings, and daily fluency documentation.

Speak in Progress helps English speakers move past reading comprehension into spontaneous, confident speech using faceless PC screen recording (OBS Studio, Windows Game Bar, macOS QuickTime) and structured active retrieval.

## Public Pages (Indexable Canonical URLs)

- [Home](https://speak-in-progress.pages.dev/): Overview of the studio, Cognitive Cadence Method, and interactive WPM calculator.
- [Features](https://speak-in-progress.pages.dev/features): Breakdown of the 4 integrated studio modules.
- [How It Works](https://speak-in-progress.pages.dev/how-it-works): 5-step daily speaking blueprint and CEFR WPM pacing calibration table.
- [About](https://speak-in-progress.pages.dev/about): Origin, founder bio (Md. Selim), and the Cognitive Cadence philosophy.
- [FAQ](https://speak-in-progress.pages.dev/faq): Direct answers on teleprompter pacing, 90-second recall, OBS workflow, and data privacy.

## Core Studio Modules

- **Interactive Teleprompter Studio**: Calibrated speaking rate (130–160 WPM), continuous auto-scroll (15–75 px/s), Paragraph Focus mode, eye-line focus beam, clean screen-recording mode (`F` shortcut), and in-app microphone rehearsal playback.
- **Cognitive Cadence & 120-Day CEFR Syllabus**: Progressive A1–C2 daily scripts pairing guided reading with an immediate 90-second unscripted memory retelling challenge and stumble-rate reflection logs.
- **16:9 High-CTR Thumbnail Studio**: Native HTML5 Canvas exporter producing 2K (2560×1440) and FHD (1920×1080) PNG thumbnails with bold typography and episode badges.
- **Video Intro, Banner & Daily YouTube Upload Kit**: Browser-rendered animated intro stingers with acoustic audio chords, 2560×1440 channel banners with desktop/mobile/TV safe zones, SVG logos, and daily YouTube title and description metadata generators.

## The Cognitive Cadence Method

Traditional language study relies heavily on passive listening and translation. Fluent speech requires motor-articulatory rhythm and rapid cognitive retrieval under gentle time pressure:
- **Subvocal Alignment (130–160 WPM)**: Continuous prompter movement eliminates mid-sentence pauses and mental translation.
- **Active Retrieval (90s Window)**: Hiding text immediately after reading forces spontaneous grammatical synthesis from memory anchors.
- **Normalizing the Stumble Rate**: Treats hesitations as objective neuro-linguistic calibration signals rather than failure.
- **Faceless PC Screen Recording**: Removes camera and lighting friction so 100% of focus stays on vocal delivery.

## Privacy & Non-Indexable Studio Boundary

Only the 5 public documentation pages listed above are indexable. The authenticated creator studio workspace, personal teleprompter drafts, rehearsal recordings, and private reflection vaults are strictly protected behind Firebase Authentication (`noindex, nofollow, noarchive, nosnippet`, `X-Robots-Tag` headers, and Cloud Firestore security rules).
